intro: We provide independent diagnostic and repair services for Tesla vehicles at a lower cost than many traditional service options. We are not a Tesla-certified or Tesla-authorized repair center and are not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.

services.name: Advanced diagnostics
services.description: Alert investigation, system scans, electrical troubleshooting, and clear next-step recommendations.

services.name: Cooling and thermal systems
services.description: Coolant leaks, pump concerns, thermal-system faults, bleeding, vacuum filling, and overheating diagnosis.

services.name: Low-voltage electrical
services.description: 12V/16V battery concerns, charging faults, wiring checks, wake/sleep issues, and parasitic draw diagnosis.

services.name: Suspension and mechanical
services.description: Control arms, links, hubs, brakes, suspension noise, steering concerns, and common mechanical repairs.

services.name: Collision and post-repair checks
services.description: Post-collision diagnostic review, warning-light investigation, sensor checks, and repair-completion inspections.

services.name: Pre-purchase inspections
services.description: Independent review before you buy, with special attention to alerts, repairs, title history, and visible condition.
